rav.text: The Azorius Senate sees Szadek arrested by Agrus Kos and imprisoned, where Augustin IV kills him and enslaves his ghost, and after Kos kills Momir Vig, the senate votes to place Ravnica under martial law under Augustin.
Prahv, the seat of Azorius power, is destroyed when the Parhelion collides with it, and the senate elects Leonos II as the new Grand Arbiter.
Later, reconstruction of New Prahv finally begins after Isperia assumes leadership of the guild.
